article.headline: Trent Mosquera scores 18 to lead Le Moyne to 87-74 victory over Fairleigh Dickinson
article.description: — Trent Mosquera scored 18 points to help Le Moyne defeat Fairleigh Dickinson 87-74 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Trent Mosquera scores 18 to lead Le Moyne to 87-74 victory over Fairleigh Dickinson

keywords: Le Moyne Dolphins @ Fairleigh Dickinson Knights
article.story: TEANECK, N.J. -- — Trent Mosquera scored 18 points to help Le Moyne defeat Fairleigh Dickinson 87-74 on Monday night. Mosquera also had six rebounds for the Dolphins (11-10, 6-2 Northeast Conference). Jakai Sanders totaled 16 points and six rebounds. Jakob Blakley shot 3 for 5 from beyond the arc to finish with 11 points. The Knights (7-14, 4-4) were led by Taeshaud Jackson, who finished with 15 points and eight rebounds. David Jevtic added 14 points and 10 rebounds. Joey Niesman recorded 14 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
